newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end sharply lower on futures expiry.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end sharply lower on futures expiry.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed sharply lower on Friday, dragged by the expiry of the February Ibex futures contract, dealers said.
The general index fell 4.58 points, 0.96 percent to 470.70 and the Ibex shed 56.90 points, 1.05 percent, to 5,377.88.
Endesa dropped 220 pesetas to 8,800, but dealers said this had no relation to 1996 results released today, which were in line with analysts forecasts.
The group posted net profit of 165.09 billion pesetas versus 149.85 billion in 1995.

"Endesa is sending a signal to the market that liberalisation will put pressure on them, as will tariff cuts...by reducing its declared real income figure," an analyst said. But the net profit figure met forecasts, he added.
Asturiana shed 80 pesetas to 1,800, but was off lows after the stocks commission said it was filing a suit against the for failing to declare a speculative position in the zinc market as of 1992.
Overall, the short-term outlook for the market is still uncertain, dealers said.
